title: People’s Mañanera September 25
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Addressing the Root Causes Yields Results  
** In Tabasco, homicides fell by 54%, kidnappings by 75%, and high-impact
crimes by 18%. President Claudia Sheinbaum explained what was key in obtaining
these results. “If we don’t address the root causes, it will be difficult to
reduce insecurity,” she said.

**Tourism That Connects and Generates Well-Being  
** Mexico has received 59.7 million visitors. Their spending exceeded US$21.74
billion and created 5.07 million jobs. This growth is accompanied by 140 new
air routes, community-based tourism, and greater connectivity through the
Mayan Train and the Interoceanic Corridor.

**More Jobs and Labor Rights  
** The President highlighted the creation of more than one million jobs in a
year: “The Mexican economy is doing well. Jobs are being created, and there is
investment,” she noted. In addition, nearly one million digital platform
workers were enrolled in the Mexican Social Security Institute (IMSS).

**The World Cup Boosts Tourism and Employment  
** The World Cup attracted 7.3 million visitors to the host cities and
generated tourism revenue of nearly US$2.9 billion. In the three host cities,
tourism-related revenue grew by more than 40%, alongside the formalization of
digital platform employment.

**Ayotzinapa: New Lines of Investigation  
** Sheinbaum announced that new developments will be reported on September 28,
including phone analyses, searches, arrests, and scientific evidence. “The
parents of the 43 missing Ayotzinapa students are kept fully informed,” she
stated.
